# Studio Production Brief: PROMPT GOD (Banned From The Discord)

## 🎯 Project Overview
- **Track Title**: PROMPT GOD (Banned From The Discord)
- **Genre & Subgenre**: Underground Hardcore Trap Rap / Chopper Diss Track
- **Tempo & Grid**: Rotating Tempo (70 BPM Half-Time Groove $\rightarrow$ 140 BPM 16th Locked Pocket $\rightarrow$ 210 BPM Chopper Triplet Switch)
- **Vocalist Profile**: Male Lead, Aggressive Strut, Razor-Sharp Enunciation, Sarcastic & Ruthless
- **Topic & Concept**: Ruthless, technically dense, and hilarious roast of Suno corporate executives and Discord server moderators banning a creator for releasing a superior prompt engineering model.

---

## 🎛️ Audio Quality & Engineering Directives
- **Quality Score**: `[AUDIO_QUALITY: MAX]` `[REALISM: MAX]`
- **Vocal Signal Chain**: Vintage Neumann U87 tube mic $\rightarrow$ Empirical Labs Distressor $\rightarrow$ Pultec 12kHz high-end air sheen $\rightarrow$ Analog Console Warmth.
- **Low-End Foundation**: Clutch sliding 808 sub-bass tuned to F minor, sub-harmonic saturation below 60Hz, zero low-end mud.
- **Drums & Percussion**: 16th locked pocket trap grid, rolling 32nd-note snares, triple-velocity hi-hat ratchets, staccato minor key piano stabs.
- **Master Specification**: 24-bit 96kHz radio master, -14 LUFS integrated loudness, 0.0 dB true peak ceiling.
